document.about: INSEE Informations rapides no. 269, industrial production index for September 2026 (Licence Ouverte), printed from a browser. The space at each place a line wraps is drawn after the line's last word, at a position inside an earlier word of it.

notes: pdftotext reads the words whole. The stray spaces are drawn out of turn and set on a letter's ink, which a space between two words never is.
